## Carrion Knight (CR 7)

This hulking creature looks like a suit of armor reinforced with bone and overgrown with rotting flesh. The yellow glow of its eyes burns with malice.  

**XP** 3,200  
NE Medium undead  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +25  


**Defense**


**AC** 25, touch 12, flat-footed 23 (+9 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)  
**hp** 143 (11d8+55)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +10  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +4;  
**DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, cold, electricity, undead traits; **SR** 18  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +16 (2d6+7/19-20 plus grab)  
**Special Attacks** blood drain (1d2 Constitution)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 11th)  


At will—disguise self, suggestion (DC 17), vampiric touch  



**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 13, Con—, **Int** 12, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +15 (+19 grapple); **CMD** 27  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (slam), Improved Initiative, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (slam), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Lightning Reflexes.*  
**Skills** Bluff +14, Disguise +26, Intimidate +16, Perception +25, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +15; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Disguise, +8 Intimidate, +8 Perception  
**Languages** Common (can’t speak); telepathy 60 ft.  
**SQ** freeze (suit of armor)  


**Special Abilities**


**Blood Healing (Su)** A carrion knight restores 5 hit points for every point of constitution damage inflicted by its blood drain ability. A carrion knight can, as a swift action, drain blood from the creature entombed within it.  

**Entomb (Ex)** A carrion knight can, as a full-round action, entomb a willing or helpless humanoid of its size within itself. The entombed creature is helpless and cannot speak or attempt to free itself on its own. An entombed creature accrues a permanent negative level for every 24 hours spent inside the carrion knight. A carrion knight is empowered for 24 hours after inflicting a negative level onto an entombed creature. When empowered, a carrion knight adds its Charisma modifier as a profane bonus to AC (+4 for most carrion knights) and acts as if created under the benefit of the desecrate spell with an altar (+2 hp per HD, +2 to attack and damage, +2 to saving throws). Ejecting a drained corpse is a full-round action for a carrion knight.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
